title: fix(plugin-detail): a long text summary roll-up wraps on the record page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg48yiCyRmnqoUoHcQ9VbBp6)_

Fixes #34182

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录详情页里,汇总(summary)字段改用它自己的只读展示 `SummaryField` 绘制,长文本汇总完整显示并自动换行;`SummaryField` 的文字颜色从写死的灰色改为主题前景色。
- 为什么改:文本型汇总此前在记录页只显示一行加省略号,完整值只在悬停提示里;公式字段已经这样修过,汇总是剩下的一半。原来的固定灰色在暗色模式下不变,直接换过去会让数字汇总在暗色下发暗。
- 风险与回滚:只影响记录详情页的汇总行和汇总字段的只读展示;列表/表格行仍是一行截断,高亮条不变。回滚即还原本 PR 两处源码改动。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`(新增的 `summary` 分支,紧挨 `formula` 分支);`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/SummaryField.tsx`(颜色类)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx packages/fields/src/__tests__/summaryFaces.numberFace-11752.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、143 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `SummaryField`'s read display takes the theme token `text-foreground` in place of the fixed `text-gray-700`, so a roll-up follows dark mode. `text-foreground` is the token the record page's value row itself sets. The sibling read faces (`FormulaField`, `CurrencyField`, `NumberField`) set no colour and inherit it.
- `DetailSection` reads a `summary` through `SummaryField`, beside the `formula` branch that reads through `FormulaField`. It matches on renderer identity and type, so a host that registered its own `summary` face keeps it. The raw value goes in and the record goes in as `dependentValues`, which a `record`-mode currency needs.
- Grid rows keep `FormulaCellRenderer` (one line, the whole value in `title`). The highlights strip is untouched.

## Tests

The new pins go into the existing shared harness files as top-level `describe` blocks. No new file is added.

- `record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx`, `objectstack#34182` blocks:
  - at 1440 px and at phone width, a 120-character text summary cell holds exactly the markup `SummaryField` renders, shows the whole value, has no one-line utility between the text and the row, and has no `title`;
  - CONTROLS: `getCellRenderer('summary')` is still `FormulaCellRenderer`, which still renders `truncate` with the whole value as `title`; a number summary still reads `1,234.50`; a host's own `summary` face is kept.
- `summaryFaces.numberFace-11752.test.tsx`: the read display carries `text-foreground` and no fixed `text-gray-*`/`slate`/`zinc`/`neutral`/`stone` shade, for a number value and for a text value.

## Acceptance notes

- `AutoNumberField`'s read display also hard-codes `text-gray-700` with no `dark:` variant. This was only read in the code: on the record page `auto_number` reads through `TextField`, so the defect is limited to the form widget. It is outside this card's file surface, so this PR does not change it, and no card is filed.
- Mechanism note: the card asks for "the token the other read displays use". Those read displays set no colour token and inherit one. This PR uses `text-foreground`, the token on the record row's value container, so the face carries a dark-mode colour in any container.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation (two legs, both red, restored by hash)</summary>

Both mutations went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (each anchor hit 1 time, then 0 times; the blob changed). The `@object-ui/fields` specifier is aliased to `src` in `ui/vitest.config.mts`, so no `dist` rebuild sits between a mutation and the run.

- Leg A: the summary branch in `DetailSection.tsx` is switched off (type `summary-ablated`). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 141 passed (143)`. The two failures are the desktop and phone cases "a summary cell holds the read display SummaryField renders, in full, and wraps". All controls stay green.
- Leg B: `text-foreground` is changed back to `text-gray-700` in `SummaryField.tsx`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 141 passed (143)`. The two failures are both cases of "the summary read display carries a dark-mode colour".
- Restore: `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes, and the working-tree blob equals the HEAD blob for both files.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- Dependency closure build (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --filter '@object-ui/fields^...'`): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Both touched test files: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 143 passed (143)`.
- `packages/fields/` plus `packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 693 passed | 2 skipped (695)`, `Tests 8142 passed | 25 skipped (8167)`.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 38 commands): 36 exit 0. `check:type-check-debt` is NOT MEASURED because its closure build never got a turn on the lock (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET); it is re-running. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Tests 5092 passed | 2 skipped`.
- `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
</details>
